note.question: How does active sequential hypothesis testing (ASHT) contribute to challenges in developing liquid biopsies for early-stage cancer detection?
note.overview: This paper addresses challenges in developing liquid biopsies for early-stage cancer detection through active sequential hypothesis testing (ASHT). In the problem of ASHT, a learner seeks to identify the true hypothesis (true cancer type) from a known set of hypotheses (candidate cancer types). The learner is given a set of actions (sequencing genetic intervals) and knows the distribution of the random outcome (whether a mutation is detected) of any action under any true hypothesis.
